title: Two years making a multiplayer TPS template for UE 5.8 — server-side rewind and an in-game map editor
author: Sami92_GameDev
selftext:
Two years of evenings on this one.

The map editor in the video is in-game. Players place pieces, save, and the map travels to everyone

else in the session with its own preview image, so you can build something and play a match in it

with a friend straight away.

Networking took the longest by far. Server-side rewind for hitscan, projectiles and shotgun pellets,

so hits land for someone on 200ms instead of making them lead by a metre.

There's a free playable build here if anyone wants to try it:

[https://doublebraingames.itch.io/ultimate-third-person-shooter](https://doublebraingames.itch.io/ultimate-third-person-shooter)

Happy to answer anything about how a particular system works.
